history.reason: precise sampled-location geometry to external Planetary Computer endpoint

history.scope: public USDA Akron sampled-support polygons and 2019-2022 date ranges to planetarycomputer.microsoft.com for HLS retrieval and model assessment

geometry.bundle_rule: convex hull of the bundle's sampled coordinates buffered 15 m
geometry.station_rule: convex hull of all eligible sampling coordinates buffered 15 m
geometry.unit_context_dependency: shared 224x224 native grid; adjacent contexts and tokens are dependent

imagery_source.assets: NASA HLS S30/L30 six 30 m reflectance bands and Fmask
imagery_source.terms: HLS source CC BY 4.0; Planetary Computer STAC license metadata requires separate review for redistribution

preview_version_scope: PNG alpha only; all accepted scientific NPZ arrays are native v2 and unchanged by preview fix
selection: latest four distinct QA-positive acquisition dates in May 1-June 15 window; ties by source item ID; sorted chronological for model; independent of labels

source.coordinate_status: public source sampling points; datum unresolved
source.name: USDA Akron public research observations
